This is a common AI artifact where text structure is approximated but not rendered correctly.
The edges of the books lack the fine detail of individual paper pages. Instead, they appear as smooth, slightly blurred blocks of color or texture, lacking the realistic striations of stacked paper.

The books and the box/container in the bottom right corner seem to merge slightly with the background and each other. The geometry of the box is ambiguous, and the books leaning against it lack clear physical separation at the contact points.
